content.text: LocationCoachella takes place at Empire Polo Club in Indio, California Dates2 Weekends In April (Annually) Coachella is North America’s most famous music festival, held each April at its now iconic home at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. Coachella started out as one weekend but due to increased demand added a second weekend in 2012. A festival on every true music fan’s bucket list, Coachella will make its eagerly anticipated return in April 2021 after a year off, once again returning with a world-beating lineup of some of music’s biggest stars, covering a range of genres, including rock, indie, hip-hop and dance. Coachella’s illustrious history has seen it feature legendary headline sets from the likes of Beyoncé, Daft Punk, Prince, Radiohead, and Bob Dylan over its two decade-long lifespan. Welcome to our all inclusive guide to Coachella! Here are a couple guides to get you started: Guide to the different Coachella stages What should I bring to Coachella? List of allowed and prohibited items at Coachella Coachella camping guide Differences between Coachella Weekend 1 and Weekend 2 Are Coachella VIP tickets worth it? What are the 2023 Coachella after parties? Coachella General FAQ Where is Coachella located? Coachella is held at the Empire Polo Club in Indio California in the Coachella Valley. When is Coachella? Coachella usually takes place during two weekends in April. How old do you have to be to attend Coachella? Coachella is open to all ages. However, all campground attendees must be 18 years or older with ID. If under 18, all attendees must be accompanied by parent or legal guardian. When does Coachella open each day? Gates for Coachella open about an hour before the first acts start at noon – around 11 AM. What time does Coachella end? Headliners usually come on around 10-11 PM each day. The festival is usually sometime between midnight and 1 AM. Can I enter Coachella at any time? As long as you are holding a ticket that has not yet been scanned that day, you may enter any time during the event. Ins & outs are not allowed (except for camping guests) Are ins and outs (re-entry) allowed at Coachella? Re-entry is allowed at Coachella, as long as you scan out, you should be able to scan in with no issues. What are the Coachella set times? Are they posted in advance? Yes. Set times will be posted on the Coachella Mobile App and website a couple of days before the festival. Set times will also be available in the Festival Guide obtained at the show. What is the closest airport to Coachella? The nearest airport is the Palm Springs airport (PSP). You can also fly into Ontario International Airport (ONT) or Los Angeles International Airport (LAX). What is Coachella’s Camera Policy? No professional cameras are allowed. No detachable lenses / DSLRs. Does Coachella have a lost and found? Yes. Lost & Found services will be available at the venue during and between show days. Can I sleep in my car or park overnight? Sleeping in cars in the festival parking lot is not permitted for anyone. DO NOT leave your car in the parking lot during non-festival hours, or it will be towed at your expense. Can I sleep in my car or park overnight at Coachella? Sleeping in cars in the festival parking lot is not permitted for anyone. DO NOT leave your car in the parking lot during non-festival hours, or it will be towed at your expense. Are lockers available for rent at Coachella? Yes! Store your stuff securely, and keep your cell phone powered up all weekend long. What can I bring inside with me? Click here for a complete list. Totems and signs are not allowed. What kind of music do they play at Coachella? Music of all genres! How old do I have to be to attend? All ages are welcome at Coachella. If you’re under 18 you’ll need to be accompanied by your parent or legal guardian. Are drugs allowed at Coachella? Coachella has a a zero-tolerance policy for drug use and possession. Police officers will be working inside and outside of the event, and all narcotics laws will be strictly enforced. Be responsible, and make smart choices. Will I be searched at Coachella? By purchasing a ticket, you agree to submit to a thorough, TSA-style search, including emptying your pockets and bags, having all of your items examined, a full pat-down, and possibly removing your shoes. We reserve the right to refuse entry to anyone. Will there be vegetarian food at the festival? Vegan? Gluten-free? All types of food will be available at the festival. Will there be sinks and flushable toilets available? Yes, in addition to porta pottys, there are many regular toilets available. Will there be ATMs on site? Where is the nearest ATM? Many ATMs will be located around the festival grounds, in addition to the general store. Will there be a Lost & Found where I can look for my missing stuff? (Keys, wallet, mobile phone, etc.) Yes. There will be a Lost & Found at the festival accessible the Venue near the main entrance. Items will also be listed in the Lost & Found section of the Coachella Mobile App. Please only give items you find to the Info Kiosks or Lost & Found directly. Do not hand over items to random staff or guards. Will there be medical services on site? Yes. Medical stations will be clearly visible on site and marked both on your Festival Guide and Mobile App. Will there be electrical outlets or charging stations for mobile phones? Electrical outlets for charging cell phones will be located in numerous locations throughout the Venue as well as in each camping lot. Bring your own charger cord. Can I get water on site? How much will it cost? Are there be free water refills? Bottled water will be sold at numerous vendor locations in both the Venue and camping. There will also be free, twice filtered, water refill stations. Each station can accommodate multiple people at a time and will be located throughout the Venue and campgrounds. GULP! You’re free to bring an empty, refillable, non-metal/aluminum/steel/glass water bottle or hydration pack.
